channel.title: Palm Coast Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Palm Coast Observer (observerlocalnews.com)

item.title: And the winners are ...: Michelle Moore is Flagler Schools Teacher of the Year; Calvin Grant is Employee of the Year
item.description: Moore is an ESE teacher at Belle Terre Elementary School. Grant is a campus security officer at Flagler Palm Coast High School. They were honored at the school district's annual award gala.

item.title: Seabreeze upsets New Smyrna Beach to win boys soccer district championship
item.description: Luke Harrell scored the only goal of the game for the Sandcrabs, who clinched a spot in the state playoffs.

item.title: Infusion therapy company Noble Infusion to open new office location in Palm Coast
item.description: Infusion therapies can be "life changing" for those suffering from chronic illnesses, founder Shaya Fogel said.

item.title: Bill by Sen. Leek requires Daytona Beach to right funding wrongs to receive state legislative money
item.description: 'Continuously, they've been brought up before the legislature, the audit committee to say, 'Hey, what are you going to do?' And every year they promise to do something,' Leek said.

item.title: Ormond Beach Fire Department honors Marc Pinkman as Firefighter of the Year
item.description: At its second annual banquet, OBFD also recognized its Driver Engineer, Paramedic and Captain of the Year.

item.title: Palm Coast Charter Review Committee to recommend council review limitations on borrowing power
item.description: The committee decided it was not up to them to place new limitations, and felt the public clearly wanted to keep limitations in place. But the amounts need to be decided by the City Council.

item.title: Palm Coast Expo to feature unveiling of new city mobile app
item.description: The Expo, organized by the Palm Coast Citizens Academy Alumni Ambassadors, will be held from 5:30 to 7:30 p.m. on Feb. 12 at the Palm Coast Community Center.

item.title: What's planned for The Hammock? Flagler County plans multiple improvement projects despite funding uncertainties
item.description: As the county reviews its future and current projects, an uncertainty over its future funding ability looms should the state remove property tax revenue.

item.title: Flagler School Board votes to add a post-hire certification to HR chief's job description
item.description: The board voted 3-1 to add Lauren Ramirez's addition to the position's qualifications.

item.title: Ormond Beach Police arrest man in connection to bomb threat at Temple Beth-El
item.description: The synagogue reported the bomb threat to law enforcement and the Temple Beth-El elementary school was placed on lockdown.
